confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on Seoul crowd-sourced and consumer-survey price points plus Gyeongju third-party budget guides, scaled down for a smaller city. Beer, coffee and the meal anchors are moderately firm. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer price (about 2.5x and 2.2x), not observed directly. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or listings were checked. FX: the extended search summary attributed 0.6955 USD per AUD to the RBA 4:00 pm indicative rate for 15 October 2026, but I did not open the RBA page, so provenance is secondhand. The source_url is the RBA exchange-rates page that appeared in search results. Won figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 1,400 KRW per USD, not a searched rate. A pending draft-beer tax change could raise draft prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seoul price points (Expatistan, a Korea Consumer Agency-based guide, combien-coute.net) used as the basis, adjusted down for Gyeongju's smaller-city, heritage-tourism setting and cross-checked against third-party Gyeongju budget guides. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Gyeongju's guesthouse and hotel stock.
